messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "consider treatment response and tolerability when selecting the maintenance dosage for pediatric patients"
set: ["consider treatment response and tolerability when selecting the maintenance dosage for pediatric patients", "consider treatment response and tolerability when selecting the maintenance dosage", "consider duration of treatment", "patients should be periodically reassessed to determine the need for maintenance treatment", "patients should be periodically reassessed for the continued need of maintenance treatment", "review should determine the need for maintenance treatment", "used for acute and maintenance treatment of major depressive disorder", "consider dose reduction when used with bupropion", "patients who tolerate the 2.4 mg dosage for at least 4 weeks", "dosage should be adjusted according to patient response", "reduce dosage after adequate response has been reached", "patients should be periodically reassessed for the appropriate dose of treatment", "titrate every 30 days to achieve maintenance dosage", "usual pediatric dose for narcolepsy", "doctor will determine right dose based on condition and response to treatment", "dose determined by doctor based on condition, age, and response to treatment"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
